_about: Flag-vs-guard eval cases (2026-09-18). Measures the classifier's prior-cycle behavior after the flag-not-guard change: a tracked candidate's own CURRENT-cycle answers are relevant + NOT flagged; their own PRIOR-cycle answers are relevant + FLAGGED (prior_cycle=true, not rejected); a WRONG-contest page (page evaluated against a race whose candidates it is not about) is GUARDED (relevant=false). Each case is a real Ballotpedia page fetched via the production peek. Grow this set as more verified cases appear. Metric is noisy (LLM) — average multiple runs; a change must beat the noise band.
